title: Packs, and the Vault behind them
thisBuild: Sounds has a new Packs button. Packs are sounds picked in the Vault (a review page Claude made) and sent to the app. Each installs as its own jar in Sounds, with Update when a newer version is sent, and Remove.
No pack has been sent yet: the first one, RC-505 Starter, waits for your review in the Vault.

The Vault holds all 600 clips cut from your 96 RC-505 stems: 322 loops (each exactly 1, 2, 4 or 8 beats), 195 single notes, 82 drum hits and a stab. Claude pre-picked 48 for the starter pack; they are marked, not kept, until you keep them.
From build 66: Qbldy Loops and Hits replace the 0.35 s chops, and loops play at your mess's tempo.
watch: Tap Packs in Sounds: it should say no packs have been sent yet.
In the Vault: J and K move, Space plays, Y keeps, N skips, P puts a clip in the pack. When the pack looks right, mark it Ready and tell Claude to send it.
limits: Packs come from the app's GitHub releases, so installing one needs a connection.
A removed pack's sounds go quiet on pads that used them until it is installed again.
Packs are free and public for now; selling them would need accounts and the Play Store's billing, which is a later decision.
